info.title: FUNCTION-DocTest-List Rideshare Rides Drivers-v3-spec
info.description: The Rideshare Driver List API enables users to access a comprehensive listing of rideshare drivers within the system. This API facilitates retrieval of vital driver information, including their availability, ratings, and service areas, making it essential for applications focused on rideshare logistics and driver management. Typical consumers of this API include rideshare platforms, fleet management systems, and mobile applications looking to integrate driver data for operational efficiency. It helps improve user experience by providing timely access to driver details necessary for matching riders with available drivers.

get.summary: Retrieve available rides for a specific driver.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch a list of rides currently assigned to a specific driver. You can use this information to monitor driver activity and manage ride assignments effectively.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving information about a driver's rides. This body should be formatted as JSON and can include necessary parameters for the query.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the list of drivers.
